{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine merino sweater, softly fitted, V-neck, hip-length, powder blue (#9DB8D3), merino wool
Midi skirt, gentle A-line, falling just below the knee, deep navy (#1F2D4A), wool crepe
Single-breasted jacket, straight cut, hip-length, slate grey (#5A6475), textured wool tweed
Sheer tights, 20 denier, dark navy (#26314D), nylon-elastane knit
Coat, straight cut, knee-length, burgundy (#6B2D3C), brushed wool
Ankle boots, low block heel of about 5 cm, almond toe, ink black-blue (#2A2F3A), smooth leather
Small crossbody bag, structured, burgundy (#6B2D3C), grained leather
Drop earrings, small, pearl-white (#F2EDE6) with silver-tone fittings, glass pearl

This outfit suits a neat evening at the theatre: a refined knit with a skirt and a textured jacket, finished with ankle boots. The powder blue near the face echoes her eye color and sits softly with her silver hair and cool, rosy skin. The navy skirt and slate jacket keep the lower part calm and elongated, and the A-line skirt with a straight jacket gives a balanced, easy shape. The burgundy coat and bag add warmth for a cool autumn evening, and the block heel is comfortable for sitting and for walking between the foyer and the seat."}
